parent_objective: critical-window config design after source-narrow tail-aligned event signal

public_gates: treat M482 tail-aligned event rows as diagnostic because they are source-narrow
design critical-window config variants that reduce recovery time after obstacle reveal
preserve zero obstacle relative velocity and P0 human-view actor inputs
define sampling stress tests before any tail-aligned proof mining
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not count single-pair repeated tail events as source-diverse proof
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: Because M482 tail-aligned wrong-history swaps create event rows only on a single source pair, a stricter critical-window task family is needed to reduce recovery time and expose source-diverse natural wrong-history event proof.
success_criteria: define one or more critical-window config variants with concrete parameter changes
define reset/sampling stress tests before any proof run
failure_criteria: design treats single-pair M482 events as proof
design proposes training before config sampling validity is checked

commands.name: critical_window_config_design
commands.command: Use M482 artifacts to design critical-window config variants and sampling/smoke gates; no training.

decision_rule: M483 should admit only config/sampling implementation work, not training, unless it preserves source-diversity discipline and actor input contract.
